adjudication.rationale: The diff in `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts` changes `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which is an inversion of the prior condition. Previously the org `slug` was set when team billing was disabled; now it is only set when billing is enabled. This is a real behavioral change visible in the diff and can plausibly break org creation when billing is disabled (slug no longer provided) and/or bypass the prior “requestedSlug” flow by setting both `slug` and `metadata.requestedSlug` when billing is enabled.
